runtime_catalog.name: WhittakerSmooth
runtime_catalog.description: Whittaker smoothing for noise reduction and signal trend estimation.

lam.description: Regularization parameter controlling smoothness of the fitted signal. Larger values yield smoother trends.

weights.description: Non-negative weights applied to each observation. If None, all observations are weighted equally.

solver_type.description: Backend used to solve the Whittaker linear system. Prefer ``"banded"`` (the default): it solves all rows in a single batched LAPACK call and is roughly **27× faster** than ``"sparse"`` at scale. Use ``"sparse"`` only as a numerical fallback for ill-conditioned problems.

n_jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs used during :meth:`transform`. Only effective when ``solver_type="sparse"``: rows are split across workers via joblib. When ``solver_type="banded"`` (the default), a single vectorised LAPACK batch solve is used regardless of this value, because it is already faster than spawning parallel workers. With ``solver_type="sparse"`` and ``n_jobs=-1``, benchmarks show roughly **4× speedup** on 8 cores.
